summary: Frontend-only testing of the new Forgot Password / Reset Password flow on Cartoonix (Romanian). Tested on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) via the preview URL. All 12 checks passed: 'Ai uitat parola?' link switches to 'Resetare parolă' view; forgot form submit for test@cartoonix.ro returns the generic Romanian success block (reset-sent) and 'Înapoi la conectare' returns to login; back-to-login-2 also works; /reset-password without token shows 'Link invalid. Cere din nou resetarea parolei.' with working reset-back-login navigation; /reset-password?token=faketoken123456 renders both password fields + submit; min-length validation shows 'Parola trebuie să aibă cel puțin 6 caractere.'; mismatch shows 'Parolele nu coincid.'; valid matching passwords with fake token return API error 'Link invalid sau deja folosit. Cere unul nou.' (backend 400 as expected, confirming API integration). Login regression with test@cartoonix.ro/test1234 still succeeds and redirects to /home (password unchanged).

issues: Minor: console warning - cartoonix-logo-autumn.webp is preloaded but not used within a few seconds after load (preload 'as' attribute / intent); cosmetic only

critical_code_review_comments: Optional UX: on /reset-password the success path toasts and navigates to /login, but there is no link back to login inside the token form if the token is invalid — user sees only the error and must edit the URL. Consider adding the 'Înapoi la conectare' link in the token branch too.
Optional: add rate-limit feedback on POST /api/auth/forgot-password in the UI (currently any error is shown as raw detail).
seed_data_creation: None. No data mutated; only anti-enumeration forgot-password request for existing test user (may send a real email).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Forgot/reset password frontend flow fully verified on desktop + mobile. Splash screen takes ~2.8s; wait for data-testid=login-email. Real reset token cannot be exercised via UI (email-only, stored hashed) — use fake token to assert the invalid-token path. Backend endpoints were verified by main agent via curl.
